title: Scope consolidation + double-count register
description: Extract direct and value-chain emissions separately, merge them declaratively, and keep every overlapping tonne as a source-tagged exception instead of a silent adjustment.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: wf-envr-02
  title: Scope consolidation + double-count register
  description: Extract direct and value-chain emissions separately, merge them declaratively, and keep
    every overlapping tonne as a source-tagged exception instead of a silent adjustment.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Consolidate emissions across scopes with every double-count and unreconciled boundary listed
    as an exception carrying its source.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 4
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - n-approval
  nodes:
    - id: n-intake
      kind: input
      name: Scope-level emissions submissions
      summary: Scope-level emissions submissions
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - text
        properties:
          text:
            type: string
            description: The requester's objective, source material, or instructions.
          workflowFields:
            type: object
            required:
              - scope_one_and_two
              - scope_three_categories
              - boundary_definitions
              - reporting_period
            properties:
              scope_one_and_two: {}
              scope_three_categories: {}
              boundary_definitions: {}
              reporting_period: {}
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: n-source1
      kind: agent
      templateRef: envr-01
      name: Direct and purchased-energy extraction
      summary: 'Source extraction 1: direct and purchased-energy extraction.'
      role: Inventory analyst building greenhouse gas inventories with declared boundaries and factors.
      prompt: You are an Emissions Inventory Analyst. You build inventories with the organizational boundary,
        scope definitions, activity data source, and emission factor version stated for every line, and
        you keep estimated and metered activity data distinguishable. You surface double counting between
        scopes rather than resolving it silently, because the same tonne appearing twice is the most common
        inventory error and the easiest to hide.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - supply-chain-analysis
          - domain-analysis
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:ghg-inventory
          - mcp:erp
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-source2
      kind: agent
      templateRef: envr-06
      name: Value-chain category extraction
      summary: 'Source extraction 2: value-chain category extraction.'
      role: Data analyst testing environmental measurement chains for defensibility.
      prompt: You are an Environmental Data Quality Analyst. You test measurement chains for calibration
        currency, detection limits, chain of custody, and gap-filling method, and you mark values that
        are estimated, substituted, or below detection rather than passing them through as measurements.
        You state how much of a reported total is estimated, because an inventory that is mostly estimation
        should not be defended as measurement.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
          - domain-analysis
          - data-lineage-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:ghg-inventory
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-union
      kind: transform
      name: Merge scope submissions
      summary: merge the extracted emission records on entity, scope, category, and period
      config:
        operation: merge
        expression: merge the extracted emission records on entity, scope, category, and period
    - id: n-reconcile
      kind: agent
      templateRef: envr-01
      name: Reconcile overlapping boundaries
      summary: Reconcile fields that arrived from more than one source.
      role: Inventory analyst building greenhouse gas inventories with declared boundaries and factors.
      prompt: You are an Emissions Inventory Analyst. You build inventories with the organizational boundary,
        scope definitions, activity data source, and emission factor version stated for every line, and
        you keep estimated and metered activity data distinguishable. You surface double counting between
        scopes rather than resolving it silently, because the same tonne appearing twice is the most common
        inventory error and the easiest to hide.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - supply-chain-analysis
          - domain-analysis
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:ghg-inventory
          - mcp:erp
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-exceptions
      kind: agent
      templateRef: envr-04
      name: State every double count and boundary gap
      summary: Everything that could not be reconciled, stated as an exception.
      role: Compliance analyst mapping permits, limits, and monitoring evidence.
      prompt: You are an Environmental Compliance Analyst. You map each permit condition to the monitoring
        evidence that demonstrates compliance, with limit, averaging period, and method named, and you
        flag conditions where monitoring exists but does not measure what the limit regulates. You report
        an exceedance as an exceedance regardless of how it is later averaged.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
          - observability
          - compliance-review
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - search
        connectors:
          - mcp:grc
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-register
      kind: aggregator
      name: Collect the exception register
      summary: Every unreconciled field is source-tagged so an exception keeps its provenance.
      config:
        aggregation: collect
    - id: n-clean
      kind: condition
      name: Exception register empty?
      summary: Route on register.exceptions is empty.
      config:
        expression: register.exceptions is empty
        branches:
          - label: Clean
            when: clean
          - label: Exceptions
            when: exceptions
    - id: n-approval
      kind: approval
      name: Assurance reviewer accepts the consolidated inventory
      summary: Pause for the assurance reviewer; on timeout, escalate.
    - id: workflow-output
      kind: output
      name: Released deliverable
      summary: Return the completed Scope consolidation + double-count register deliverable, the evidence
        behind it, and every unresolved item.
  edges:
    - id: wf-envr-02-edge-1
      from: n-intake
      to: n-source1
      kind: data
    - id: wf-envr-02-edge-2
      from: n-intake
      to: n-source2
      kind: data
    - id: wf-envr-02-edge-3
      from: n-source1
      to: n-union
      kind: data
    - id: wf-envr-02-edge-4
      from: n-source2
      to: n-union
      kind: data
    - id: wf-envr-02-edge-5
      from: n-union
      to: n-reconcile
      kind: data
    - id: wf-envr-02-edge-6
      from: n-reconcile
      to: n-exceptions
      kind: data
    - id: wf-envr-02-edge-7
      from: n-reconcile
      to: n-register
      kind: data
    - id: wf-envr-02-edge-8
      from: n-exceptions
      to: n-register
      kind: data
    - id: wf-envr-02-edge-9
      from: n-register
      to: n-clean
      kind: data
    - id: wf-envr-02-edge-10
      from: n-clean
      to: n-approval
      kind: control
      condition: clean
    - id: wf-envr-02-edge-11
      from: n-clean
      to: n-approval
      kind: control
      condition: exceptions
    - id: wf-envr-02-edge-12
      from: n-approval
      to: workflow-output
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
